Question
========
What is an example of data inconsistency?

Answerlist
----------
* duplicate records for unique values
* outdated measurements
* using “1.84 m” in one dataset and “184 cm” in another
* using an abbreviation "DE" instead of "Germany"


Solution
========
Using “1.84 m” in one dataset and “184 cm" in another is an example of data inconsistency.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* False
